Container.Name: Jesselicious
Container.Overview: Your gym log on your own server. Log workouts, routines, progress and nutrition from any browser at home. No account, no cloud: everything stays in your appdata folder. The Jesselicious phone app (Android, iOS) can share data with it through Syncthing. Guide: https://github.com/InlitX/jesselicious-core/blob/main/SELFHOST.md

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Your workouts, photos and daily copies. Back up this folder and you have everything.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Password to open Jesselicious, 8 or more characters. Leave it empty for no password.

Config.Name: People
Config.Description: Several people, each with their own data: names separated by commas, like Ana, Pablo. Leave it empty if it is just you.

Config.Name: Days of daily copies
Config.Description: How many daily copies of your data to keep in the history folder.
